rule: Across an independent flower-colour radiation, phylogenetic predictability should peak at an intermediate biologically grounded representation that is finer than coarse pigment presence/absence but coarser than exact visible hue.

fourth_radiation.source_scope: 227 Iris taxa in the source phylogenetic sampling frame before source-specified exclusions
fourth_radiation.why_unused: Iris was present only as a Phase-1 atlas/control candidate and was not used to derive the 3-radiation macro state-granularity result or the Iochrominae/Cape-Erica/Petunieae matched molecular-axis result.
public_inputs_to_ingest_only_after_freez: Supplementary Table 1: row-level flower-colour and pigment traits
Supplementary Material 1: source GenBank accession list

known_before_freeze: source paper methods define seven human-visible hue categories and pigment categories
source paper states that a phylogeny was reconstructed from six loci
source paper reports aggregate trait frequencies and its own ancestral-state/phylogenetic-signal analyses
not_inspected_or_computed_for_this_test_: CHUN pairwise same-state AUC at any of the three frozen resolutions

primary_analysis_frame.taxa: Iris tips present in the reconstructed outcome-independent phylogeny with one unambiguous visible hue and one unambiguous major-pigment state; source-specified Iris darwasica exclusion retained; outgroups removed before trait analysis
primary_analysis_frame.rare_fine_state_rule: Fine hue states represented by fewer than 5 eligible tips are excluded from the primary frame; the same resulting tip set is then used for coarse, intermediate and fine analyses.
primary_analysis_frame.missingness_rule: No imputation. Taxa missing any primary-resolution state are excluded from all three primary-resolution analyses.

coarse.name: PIGMENT_PRESENCE
coarse.construction: Derived only from the admitted source pigment state; anthocyanin and/or carotenoid presence -> CHROMATIC_PIGMENT_PRESENT, neither -> NO_CHROMATIC_PIGMENT.

intermediate.name: MAJOR_PIGMENT_CLASS
intermediate.construction: Use the source major-pigment coding. Primary frame excludes taxa coded simultaneously into multiple pigment classes.

fine.name: VISIBLE_HUE
fine.construction: Use source hue coding; primary frame excludes polymorphic or bicoloured taxa assigned to multiple hue categories.

phylogeny_reconstruction.tree: IQ-TREE2 partitioned concatenation with ModelFinder and 1000 ultrafast bootstrap replicates
phylogeny_reconstruction.rooting: source outgroups when available; prune outgroups before trait statistic

primary_statistic.name: PAIRWISE_PHYLOGENETIC_SAME_STATE_AUC
primary_statistic.definition: For all unordered eligible tip pairs, outcome=1 when the pair has the same state at the focal resolution and 0 otherwise; predictor is negative patristic distance. AUC therefore measures whether phylogenetically closer pairs are more likely to share state.
primary_statistic.permutation_unit: permute the complete coarse/intermediate/fine state triplet jointly across tips so marginal state frequencies and cross-resolution dependence are preserved while phylogenetic association is destroyed
reported: one-sided empirical p for intermediate signal
one-sided empirical p for each intermediate-superiority delta

decision_rule.PASS: AUC_intermediate > 0.5 with empirical p<=0.05 AND delta_intermediate_minus_coarse>0 with empirical p<=0.05 AND delta_intermediate_minus_fine>0 with empirical p<=0.05.
decision_rule.MIXED: AUC_intermediate >0.5 with empirical p<=0.05 and both observed deltas are positive, but one or both delta p-values exceed 0.05; OR exactly one superiority contrast is positive/significant without the other being significantly negative.
decision_rule.FAIL: AUC_intermediate is not above 0.5, or either coarse/fine resolution is significantly more predictive than intermediate under the frozen joint-permutation test.
decision_rule.NO_POST_HOC_UPGRADE: Sensitivity analyses cannot upgrade MIXED/FAIL to PASS.

planned_sensitivities: repeat on source-complete taxa without the >=5-tip fine-state frequency filter
repeat using topology-only pair distance (number of intervening branches) instead of branch-length patristic distance
report but do not use source polymorphic/bicoloured taxa in a set-valued exact-match sensitivity
claim_if_pass: An independently held-out fourth radiation supports the CHUN intermediate-resolution rule: flower-colour phylogenetic predictability is strongest at a biologically grounded pigment-class representation rather than at a binary pigment-presence state or exact visible hue.
claim_boundary: A PASS would be prospective for the frozen CHUN statistic and resolution ordering, not a claim that the Iris literature was unseen, not a universal causal law, and not evidence that the same intermediate partition must win in every radiation.
